\section{\texttt{run\_benchmark}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.benchmarking.run_benchmark}\index{Functions!run\_benchmark}

Benchmark the four pipeline phases and return a typed report.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
run_benchmark(*, dataset_path: str | Path, queries_path: str | Path, repetitions: int = 5, warmup: int = 1, top_k: int = 4, settings: Settings | None = None) -> BenchmarkReport
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{dataset\_\allowbreak{}path}] \texttt{str \textbar{} Path}, required, keyword-only. Feedback CSV used to build the index.
  \item[\texttt{queries\_\allowbreak{}path}] \texttt{str \textbar{} Path}, required, keyword-only. JSONL evaluation cases supplying benchmark questions.
  \item[\texttt{repetitions}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{5}, keyword-only. Number of measured repetitions per phase (\textgreater{}= 1).
  \item[\texttt{warmup}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{1}, keyword-only. Number of discarded warmup repetitions per phase (\textgreater{}= 0).
  \item[\texttt{top\_\allowbreak{}k}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{4}, keyword-only. Number of chunks retrieved per query.
  \item[\texttt{settings}] \texttt{Settings \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}, keyword-only. Optional settings override; defaults to a local configuration.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{BenchmarkReport}. A \texttt{BenchmarkReport} with per-phase summary statistics.
\apifield{Raises}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{ValueError}] If \texttt{repetitions} \textless{} 1, \texttt{warmup} \textless{} 0, or there are no queries.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}The benchmark builds a fresh in-memory index from \texttt{dataset\_\allowbreak{}path} (the persisted application index is never touched) and uses the deterministic local LLM provider unless \texttt{settings} selects another one.
